name: Dear Rebeca
source:
Dear Rebeca is a visual novel of short duration, where you will question reality in your search for answers. A story where life, death and the soul of a poor doll named Rebeca are mixed.

[From [url=https://eroraen.itch.io/dear-rebeca]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《亲爱的丽贝卡》是一部时长较短的视觉小说，你将在寻找答案的过程中质疑现实。这是一个关于生命、死亡和一个名叫丽贝卡的可怜娃娃的灵魂混合在一起的故事。

[来自[url=https://eroraen.itch.io/dear-rebeca]Itch.io[/url]]
